claims.text: renderOverdueRisk is added to src/ap_portal/index.js and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary. Those existing exports are unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or []. It throws TypeError for any other non-array. Otherwise it returns <table class="overdue-risk">, a plain header row (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount), and one <tr class="risk-…"> per row in the given order.

The amount is handled only as a string matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$ and is padded to two decimals as text. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never called on it, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '). The row class is restricted to the four risk values; any other value renders risk-unknown.
